---
title: "Coding Sandbox"
subtitle: "Write Python to build a graph and watch the visualization update"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
---

This page uses a Pyodide-powered Python editor to build a graph with a small NetworkX-like API and immediately redraws the graph in the browser. The editor output is converted to a plain `{nodes, edges}` payload and sent to a D3-powered graph view.

The editor supports a small NetworkX-like API:

- `G = nx.Graph()`
- `G.add_node(name)`
- `G.add_edge(u, v, weight=1)`
- `G.nodes()`
- `G.edges()`
- `G.degree(node)`

```{=html}
<div id="graph-widget-1" class="graph-widget">
  <div class="graph-widget__columns">
    <div class="graph-widget__panel">
      <h3>Edit Python graph code</h3>
      <label for="python-editor-1">Python (uses a small <code>networkx</code>-like <code>nx</code> shim)</label>
      <textarea id="python-editor-1" data-role="python-editor" rows="14">import json

G = nx.Graph()
G.add_edge("Alice", "Bob")
G.add_edge("Bob", "Carol")
G.add_edge("Carol", "Dave")
G.add_edge("Alice", "Dave")
G.add_edge("Bob", "Eve")
G.add_edge("Eve", "Frank")
G.add_edge("Frank", "Carol")

# Optional: inspect or modify the graph
print("nodes:", list(G.nodes()))
print("edges:", list(G.edges()))

# The renderer uses G if graph_output is not defined.
# You can also set graph_output manually to a {"nodes": [...], "edges": [...]} dict.
</textarea>
      <div class="graph-widget__row">
        <button data-role="run-code">Run Python</button>
        <button data-role="reset-code" class="secondary">Reset code</button>
        <button data-role="show-json" class="secondary">Show current JSON</button>
      </div>
      <pre data-role="json-output" class="graph-widget__json" hidden></pre>
      <div data-role="status" class="graph-widget__status"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="graph-widget__output">
      <div class="graph-widget__viewport-container" data-role="viewport-container"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="./graph-files/graph-display.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="./graph-files/styles.css">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js"></script>
<script type="module">
  import { GraphApp } from "./graph-files/graph-app.js";
  GraphApp.mount(document.getElementById("graph-widget-1"), { d3: window.d3 });
</script>
```
